title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.4.0 adds opt-in distillate induction: deterministic candidates from core/high ledgers, human approval for rule templates, and rollback-governed review records for structural weaknesses and hazard predictions. It does not claim production performance, statistical optimality, or proven generalization gains.
notes: Prepared metadata for RHEM v0.4.0. The Zenodo concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.22681163; the v0.4.0 version DOI is assigned by the corresponding GitHub release.
